newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Oct 15.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices jumped $5 per tonne on Tuesday in line with higher crude prices. There were plenty of enquiries, but trades were limited, traders said. Most shipowners were cautious, watching latest developments in Iraq, a major said. Others said some buyers were sidelined, expecting prices to ease later this week. MDO prices were steady but gas oil was slightly firmer. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
